what: deploy_vii.live.tools read_pages bound on a line source (B22 follow-up, PF-R7)
allowed_on_line_source: last-first+1 <= max_spans_per_read, OR (last-first+1 <= max_lines_per_line_read AND the measured bytes <= max_line_read_bytes); the line-count check comes before any iteration over the range
measure: sum of len(span.text.encode('utf-8')) over the located line:N spans first..last; a line the source does not hold counts 0
page_sources: unchanged: at most max_spans_per_read pages, refusal text unchanged
line_refusal: bad arguments: on a line source, at most 5 lines, or at most 200 lines totalling 8192 bytes, per call
tool_description: Verbatim text of pages first_page..last_page of one source (at most 5 pages; on a line source, at most 5 lines, or at most 200 lines totalling 8192 bytes), each page or line as a SOURCE block with its locator.
why: Model-testing pilot 2026-11-02: under B22 an HTML filing is a line source, so 5 spans are about 1.3 KB per call and 16 calls see about 80 lines of a 1.6 MB pack (MANAGER root-cause note).
amended_by: PF-R9 (controller gate finding PF1-G1: an unbounded last_page made both loops unbounded)
